summary: Describes UDP-Lite, a variant of UDP that lets an application say how much of each packet the checksum must cover. Packets with damage outside that area can still be delivered, which suits audio and video that tolerate some bit errors, especially on noisy links. With full coverage it behaves like UDP.

eli5.summary: Normally a package with any scratch is thrown away. UDP-Lite lets you say a small scratch is okay, so a mostly fine song or video still arrives.
